bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
echo ROOT=PASS
echo ROOT_SHA="$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
if docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker inspect -f 'RUNNING={{.State.Running}} IMAGE={{.Image}} RESTARTS={{.RestartCount}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
else echo CONTAINER=MISSING; fi
for tag in gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-candidate gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-pr62-20261120; do
 if docker image inspect "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "TAG_PRESENT=$tag"; else echo "TAG_ABSENT=$tag"; fi
done
echo USERBOT="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
